sources: own knowledge of the game (facts written for this def)
notes: Genre: Simulation. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
Play as the farm girl: stamina and fatigue limit each day.
Shipping bin pays at 5 PM.
widgets.label: Day

widgets.text: A use tool / talk, B run / cancel, R/L switch tool/item, Start menu
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Bachelors: Cliff, Doctor, Gray, Kai, Rick (and the Harvest King).
Gifts raise affection; Blue Feather to propose.
widgets.label: Marriage

widgets.text:
Water crops every non-rainy day.
Storms keep you indoors.
Festivals close shops.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Farm, town, Mother's Hill, beach, hot spring, the mines.
widgets.label: Places

widgets.text: 30 days each: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter.
widgets.label: Seasons

widgets.text:
Hoe, axe, hammer, watering can, sickle, fishing rod, milker, brush, shears.
Saibara upgrades tools with ores.
widgets.label: Tools

widgets.text: Power Berries raise max stamina; ship every item type for the shipping list.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Grow the farm, expand the house, marry and raise a family.
widgets.label: Goal
